demo.title: gondi.sh
demo.code:
# Floor price and top bid of a collection (read-only, no API key)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.gondi.xyz/mcp \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_collection_market","arguments":{"slug":"pudgypenguins"}}}'

# How much one NFT can borrow right now
curl -sS -X POST https://api.gondi.xyz/mcp \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_borrow_quote","arguments":{"collection_slug":"pudgypenguins","token_id":"4507"}}}'

setup: Nothing to install: no API key, no account, no wallet
Calls the hosted GONDI MCP server at https://api.gondi.xyz/mcp, with an MCP client or with curl
Read-only: it never signs or sends a transaction
